entities.name: PMID:29018940
observations: Pediatric ASBO systematic review/meta-analysis: three observational studies, no randomized trials; laparoscopy associated with fewer complications (OR 0.51, 95% CI 0.40–0.66), but serious bias and very-low-certainty evidence.

entities.name: PMID:37978001
observations: California cohort of 545 operated children (2007–2020): laparoscopy associated with fewer complications, resections, TPN use, readmissions, and shorter stay than open surgery; observational comparison, 30% laparoscopic.

entities.name: PMID:36896265
observations: Single-center retrospective series of 75 surgically confirmed pediatric SBO cases; recommends laparoscopic exploration first-line in stable patients; symptom duration >48 hours or interloop free ascites supports urgent intervention.

entities.name: PMID:41602887
observations: Retrospective comparison: laparoscopy completed in 29/40 children (72.5%); 11 converted. Stay and fasting were shorter, while intraoperative and postoperative complication rates were similar to open surgery.
